rules.rule: INSTRO / instrumental-only material is forbidden for K-KUT buyer flow, HUG customer selection, and II delivery paths.
Holiday LT-PIX is forbidden when directly used for that same specific holiday buyer path.
Music Maykers, LT-PIX, internal source labels, and internal inventory names must not display on public UI.
Do not create the same II twice unless ADMIN explicitly directs it.
mKs / mini-KUTs are forbidden in public buyer flow unless ADMIN override is active.
